item.title: Netflix teases new action crime thriller starring Ben Affleck and Matt Damon in new trailer.
item.description: Upon discovering millions in cash in a derelict stash house, trust among a team of Miami cops begins to fray. item.title: Gibson celebrates 50 years in Nashville in new short film.
item.description: Famed guitar makers, Gibson, moved to Nashville 50 years ago with sawdust on our boots and a heart full of songs, and were welcomed with open arms. Since then, we’ve been building dreams out of mahogany and maple, one guitar at a time. Not in some factory—in a craftory. A place where people matter.
